function.description: Remove every line of a JSON-lines file whose <key> equals one of <values>. Backs up to <file>.bak, verifies every remaining line parses and the counts match, then replaces atomically; a single bad line refuses the rewrite and leaves the file untouched.
function.name: filesystem_jsonl_remove

parameters.description:
056 WS2: remove every line whose `key` equals one of `values`; backs the
file up to `<file>.bak` first, verifies every remaining line parses and
counts match, then atomically replaces. A single bad line refuses the whole
rewrite (the store is left untouched) and names the line.

values.description: Values of `key` whose lines are removed (compared as strings).
